title: Class-conditional observability for multimodal fusion: code and results
description: Experiment code and complete per-seed result files for the article 'Width-confounded modality importance in multimodal fusion: per-class estimation before training and the width bias of learned attention'. Contains the synthetic ground-truth generator, the five removal operators, the gated-fusion arms and rank interventions, and one JSON per experiment holding the exact arrays the article reports. No manuscript sources and no third-party corpora are included.
